desc.de: Vollständig verwalteter Container-Orchestrator. Cluster mit Fargate (serverless) und EC2 Launch Types. Service Discovery (Cloud Map), ECS Exec, Capacity Providers, Service Connect, Deployment Circuit Breaker.
desc.en: Fully managed container orchestrator. Clusters with Fargate (serverless) and EC2 launch types. Service Discovery (Cloud Map), ECS Exec, Capacity Providers, Service Connect, Deployment Circuit Breaker.

tcpDesc.de: ⚠️ Status: Beta/Preview (Leistungsbeschreibung §3.12, nur EU-DE); Die Roadmap nennt kein Datum für das GA-Release. Serverless Container-Engine ohne Cluster. Pods direkt deployen (max. 5 Container/Pod), pay-per-use. Nur VPC-Netzwerk, nur SWR-Images (kein 3rd-party Registry), nur Linux x86, 30 GB rootfs ohne EVS. CPU/RAM in festen Kombinationen (0.25–64 vCPU, Ratio 1:1 bis 1:8). Für Produktion CCE (Managed K8s) empfohlen. Ein CCI-Upgrade für PV/PVC-Management ist laut Roadmap für Dez 2026–Feb 2027 vorgesehen.
tcpDesc.en: ⚠️ Status: beta/preview (service description §3.12, EU-DE only); The roadmap gives no date for the GA release. Serverless container engine without clusters. Deploy pods directly (max 5 containers/pod), pay-per-use. VPC networking only, SWR images only (no 3rd-party registry), Linux x86 only, 30 GB rootfs without EVS. CPU/RAM in fixed combinations (0.25–64 vCPU, ratio 1:1 to 1:8). CCE (Managed K8s) is recommended for production. A CCI upgrade for PV/PVC management is planned on the roadmap for Dec 2026–Feb 2027.

alt.de: CCE (Managed Kubernetes) — empfohlen für Produktion. Kubernetes auf VMs (self-managed). Rancher, OpenShift.
alt.en: CCE (Managed Kubernetes) — recommended for production. Kubernetes on VMs (self-managed). Rancher, OpenShift.

migration.de: **Architekturwechsel.** ECS (proprietär, Cluster/Service/Task) → CCI (serverless K8s-Pods, kein Cluster-Konzept). Task Definitions komplett in K8s Pod-Specs umschreiben. **Feature-Lücken.** Kein Service Discovery (Cloud Map), kein ECS Exec, keine Capacity Providers, kein Service Connect, kein Deployment Circuit Breaker, keine Task Placement Strategies. **Registry & Images.** CCI unterstützt NUR SWR — keine externen Registries, keine CRDs. Container Images von ECR nach SWR migrieren. **Ressourcen-Limits.** Max 5 Container pro Pod, nur x86. CPU/RAM in festen Kombinationen (0.25–64 vCPU, Ratio 1:1 bis 1:8). Ohne EVS nur 30 GB Storage. Nicht alle ECS Task Sizes abbildbar. **Monitoring.** ECS Exec nicht verfügbar — Debugging nur über Logs (AOM/LTS). Auto Scaling nur indirekt über AOM-Alarms statt Target Tracking. IAM Task Roles → T Cloud Public IAM Agencies. **Persistenter Speicher.** PV/PVC-Erstellung, -Binding und -Management sind laut Roadmap erst für das CCI-Upgrade in Dez 2026–Feb 2027 vorgesehen; bis zur dokumentierten Verfügbarkeit nicht einplanen. Für Produktion CCE (Managed K8s) evaluieren.
migration.en: **Architecture change.** ECS (proprietary, Cluster/Service/Task) → CCI (serverless K8s pods, no cluster concept). Task Definitions must be completely rewritten as K8s Pod specs. **Feature gaps.** No Service Discovery (Cloud Map), no ECS Exec, no Capacity Providers, no Service Connect, no Deployment Circuit Breaker, no Task Placement Strategies. **Registry & images.** CCI supports SWR ONLY — no external registries, no CRDs. Migrate container images from ECR to SWR. **Resource limits.** Max 5 containers per pod, x86 only. CPU/RAM in fixed combinations (0.25–64 vCPU, ratio 1:1 to 1:8). Without EVS only 30 GB storage. Not all ECS Task sizes mappable. **Monitoring.** ECS Exec not available — debugging only via logs (AOM/LTS). Auto Scaling only indirectly via AOM alarms instead of Target Tracking. IAM Task Roles → T Cloud Public IAM Agencies. **Persistent storage.** The roadmap targets PV/PVC creation, binding, and management for the CCI upgrade in Dec 2026–Feb 2027; do not rely on it until documented availability. For production evaluate CCE (Managed K8s).

equivNote.de: CCI ist serverless ohne Cluster-Konzept — ECS hat Cluster mit Fargate/EC2. Fehlend: Service Discovery (Cloud Map), ECS Exec, Capacity Providers, Service Connect, Deployment Circuit Breaker, Task Placement Strategies. CCI unterstützt keine CRDs und keine Drittanbieter-Image-Registries. Max 5 Container pro Pod, nur x86. Für komplexe Orchestrierung CCE (Managed K8s) evaluieren.
equivNote.en: CCI is serverless without cluster concept — ECS has clusters with Fargate/EC2. Missing: Service Discovery (Cloud Map), ECS Exec, Capacity Providers, Service Connect, Deployment Circuit Breaker, Task Placement Strategies. CCI does not support CRDs or third-party image registries. Max 5 containers per pod, x86 only. For complex orchestration evaluate CCE (Managed K8s).

tfNote.de: Teilunterstützung: CCI v2 unterstützt Namespaces, Netzwerke, Pods, Secrets und ConfigMaps sowie passende Data Sources. Es gibt keine direkten Terraform-Pendants für ECS-Cluster, Services, Task Definitions, Deployments oder Service Discovery.
tfNote.en: Partial support: CCI v2 supports namespaces, networks, pods, secrets, and ConfigMaps, plus matching data sources. There are no direct Terraform equivalents for ECS clusters, services, task definitions, deployments, or service discovery.

desc.de: Managed Container Registry. Private/Public Repos, automatisches Vulnerability Scanning (Inspector), Lifecycle Policies, Cross-Region Replication, Image Signing, Pull-Through Cache.
desc.en: Managed container registry. Private/public repos, automatic vulnerability scanning (Inspector), lifecycle policies, cross-region replication, image signing, pull-through cache.

tcpDesc.de: Container-Image-Registry mit Organisations-Struktur (Organization → Repository → Image:Tag). Private und öffentliche Images, Berechtigungen (Read/Write/Manage) pro Organisation oder Image-Repository, Image Sharing mit bis zu 500 Accounts (nur gleiche Region). Keine dokumentierten Push-Trigger/Webhooks. Kein natives Vulnerability Scanning — Trivy/Clair extern integrieren. Retention Policies (seit 06/2025 in EU-DE und EU-NL) unterstützen Regeln nach Tag-Anzahl und Alter (Tage) mit Tag-/Regex-Filtern. SWR Enterprise Edition ist laut Roadmap für März–Dez 2027 geplant.
tcpDesc.en: Container image registry with organization structure (Organization → Repository → Image:Tag). Private and public images, permissions (read/write/manage) per organization or image repository, image sharing with up to 500 accounts (same region only). No documented push triggers/webhooks. No native vulnerability scanning — integrate Trivy/Clair externally. Retention policies (since 06/2025 in EU-DE and EU-NL) support rules by tag count and age (days) with tag/regex filters. SWR Enterprise Edition is planned on the roadmap for Mar–Dec 2027.

migration.de: **Organisations-Struktur.** SWR nutzt Organization → Repository → Image:Tag — grundlegend anders als ECR (per-Account, per-Region). Berechtigungen auf Organisations- oder Image-Repository-Ebene vergeben. **Vulnerability Scanning.** Kein natives Scanning — Trivy oder Clair als CI-Pipeline-Step einbauen, alternativ HSS Container Edition. **Lifecycle Policies.** Tag- und datumsbasierte Aufbewahrungsregeln sind verfügbar; die ECR-Regeln müssen in das SWR-Policy-Format übertragen werden. **Fehlende Features.** Cross-Region Replication, Pull-Through Cache und Image Signing (Cosign/Notary) fehlen — Images manuell in andere Regionen pushen, Signing extern lösen. **Deployment-Trigger.** Keine dokumentierten Push-Trigger/Webhooks — automatische CCE-Deployments über die CI/CD-Pipeline auslösen. **CCI-Einschränkung.** CCI unterstützt ausschließlich SWR — keine externen Registries.
migration.en: **Organization structure.** SWR uses Organization → Repository → Image:Tag — fundamentally different from ECR (per-account, per-region). Permissions are granted at organization or image-repository level. **Vulnerability scanning.** No native scanning — integrate Trivy or Clair as CI pipeline step, alternatively HSS Container Edition. **Lifecycle policies.** Tag- and date-based retention rules are available; translate ECR rules to the SWR policy format. **Missing features.** Cross-region replication, pull-through cache, and image signing (Cosign/Notary) are missing — push images to other regions manually, handle signing externally. **Deployment triggers.** No documented push triggers/webhooks — trigger automatic CCE deployments from the CI/CD pipeline. **CCI restriction.** CCI supports SWR exclusively — no external registries.

equivNote.de: SWR nutzt Organization → Repository Hierarchie (nicht per-Account wie ECR). Kein natives Vulnerability Scanning (Trivy selbst integrieren). Kein Cross-Region Replication. Retention Policies nach Tag-Anzahl oder Alter mit Tag-/Regex-Filtern (weniger flexibel als ECR Lifecycle Rules). Kein Image Signing, kein Pull-Through Cache, keine dokumentierten Push-Trigger.
equivNote.en: SWR uses Organization → Repository hierarchy (not per-account like ECR). No native vulnerability scanning (integrate Trivy yourself). No cross-region replication. Retention policies by tag count or age with tag/regex filters (less flexible than ECR lifecycle rules). No image signing, no pull-through cache, no documented push triggers.

desc.de: Managed Kubernetes Service. Control Plane vollständig verwaltet, Fargate für serverlose Pods, EKS Anywhere für Hybrid.
desc.en: Managed Kubernetes service. Fully managed control plane, Fargate for serverless pods, EKS Anywhere for hybrid.

tcpDesc.de: Hochskalierbare, hochperformante Enterprise-Kubernetes-Cluster (CNCF-zertifiziert). Control Plane verwaltet, Node Pools, Helm-Support, Add-ons, Persistent Storage via EVS/SFS.
tcpDesc.en: Highly scalable, high-performance, enterprise-class Kubernetes clusters (CNCF certified). Managed control plane, node pools, Helm support, add-ons, persistent storage via EVS/SFS.

migration.de: **K8s-Versionen.** CCE nutzt andere Kubernetes-Versionen als EKS — Versionskompatibilität und API-Deprecations vorab prüfen. **Node Pools.** EKS Managed Node Groups → CCE Node Pools (ähnliches Konzept, andere API). EKS Fargate Profile → CCI (serverless, aber anderes Networking-Modell). **Ingress & Load Balancing.** AWS Load Balancer Controller → T Cloud Public ELB Ingress Controller mit abweichenden Annotations. **IAM-Integration.** EKS IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) → CCE Workload Identity (OIDC: Service-Account-Token gegen IAM-Identity-Provider) — ähnliches Prinzip, andere Einrichtung. **Storage-Treiber.** EBS CSI Driver → EVS CSI Driver. EFS CSI → SFS Turbo CSI. **Pod-Networking.** VPC CNI → Cloud Native Network 2.0 (CCE Turbo, Pods erhalten VPC-IPs aus eigenen Pod-Subnetzen) oder VPC-/Tunnel-Netzwerk (CCE) — Netzwerk-Modell bei der Cluster-Erstellung festlegen.
migration.en: **K8s versions.** CCE uses different Kubernetes versions than EKS — verify version compatibility and API deprecations beforehand. **Node pools.** EKS Managed Node Groups → CCE Node Pools (similar concept, different API). EKS Fargate Profile → CCI (serverless, but different networking model). **Ingress & load balancing.** AWS Load Balancer Controller → T Cloud Public ELB Ingress Controller with different annotations. **IAM integration.** EKS IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) → CCE workload identity (OIDC: service account token against an IAM identity provider) — similar principle, different setup. **Storage drivers.** EBS CSI Driver → EVS CSI Driver. EFS CSI → SFS Turbo CSI. **Pod networking.** VPC CNI → Cloud Native Network 2.0 (CCE Turbo, pods get VPC IPs from dedicated pod subnets) or VPC/tunnel network (CCE) — choose the network model at cluster creation.

desc.de: Kubernetes-Distribution von AWS für On-Premises/Edge (EKS-D) mit zentraler Sicht über EKS Connector; Flottenverwaltung mehrerer Cluster.
desc.en: AWS Kubernetes distribution for on-premises/edge (EKS-D) with central view via EKS Connector; fleet management of multiple clusters.

tcpDesc.de: Zentrale Verwaltung mehrerer Kubernetes-Cluster (CCE, On-Premises, andere Clouds): Flotten, Berechtigungen, Cluster-Föderation (Multi-Cluster-Workloads, FederatedHPA), Multi-Cluster-Ingress (MCI) und -Services (MCS). Nur EU-DE; Upgrade laut Roadmap März–Dez 2027.
tcpDesc.en: Central management of multiple Kubernetes clusters (CCE, on-premises, other clouds): fleets, permissions, cluster federation (multi-cluster workloads, FederatedHPA), multi-cluster ingress (MCI) and services (MCS). EU-DE only; upgrade on the roadmap for Mar–Dec 2027.

migration.de: **Unterschiedlicher Fokus.** EKS Anywhere liefert die Kubernetes-Distribution für eigene Hardware; UCS verwaltet bestehende Cluster zentral. **Cluster-Anbindung.** On-Prem-Cluster per proxy-agent (öffentliches oder privates Netz) an UCS anbinden; CCE-Cluster nativ. **Policies.** Kein dokumentiertes Policy Center in UCS — Gatekeeper-/Kyverno-Policies per GitOps auf die Cluster verteilen. **Alternative.** Rancher mit dem T Cloud Public RKE2-Node-Driver für hybride Szenarien.
migration.en: **Different focus.** EKS Anywhere provides the Kubernetes distribution for own hardware; UCS centrally manages existing clusters. **Cluster attachment.** Connect on-prem clusters to UCS via proxy-agent (public or private network); CCE clusters natively. **Policies.** No documented policy center in UCS — roll out Gatekeeper/Kyverno policies to clusters via GitOps. **Alternative.** Rancher with the T Cloud Public RKE2 node driver for hybrid scenarios.

equivNote.de: UCS ist Multi-Cluster-Management, keine eigene On-Prem-Kubernetes-Distribution.
equivNote.en: UCS is multi-cluster management, not an own on-prem Kubernetes distribution.

tfNote.de: Keine Terraform-Ressourcen für UCS im Provider.
tfNote.en: No Terraform resources for UCS in the provider.
